# Uncle Joe's Roofing

> Veteran-owned, owner-led roofing company in Blue Bell, PA. Asphalt shingle roof replacement, roof repair, free roof inspections and solar-ready roofs for Conshohocken, Blue Bell, Malvern, Paoli and nearby Montgomery and Chester County towns. Phone 610-651-3778. PA HIC PA203681. Tagline: "Call Your Uncle."

## Services
- [Roof Replacement](https://unclejoesroofing.com/roof-replacement/): full tear-off asphalt shingle roof replacement
- [Roof Repair](https://unclejoesroofing.com/roof-repair/): leak repair, storm damage, emergency tarping
- [Free Roof Inspection](https://unclejoesroofing.com/free-roof-inspection/): free inspection with photos, no obligation
- [Solar-Ready Roofs](https://unclejoesroofing.com/solar-ready-roofs/): roofs prepared for future solar panels (we do not install panels)

## Company
- [Our Story](https://unclejoesroofing.com/our-story/): owner Joe Lesher, U.S. Army veteran; named for a great-great-uncle whose yellow shutters carried white anchors
- [Contact](https://unclejoesroofing.com/contact/)
